programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Olimpia Milano" - "Baskonia"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: The highest mountains on Earth are home to snow leopards, golden eagles, mountain goats, barnacle goslings and gelada monkeys. But only the toughest can endure the extreme weather, scarce food supplies and limited oxygen on these peaks. Showcasing never-before-filmed animal behaviour using new technology to capture fresh angles and scales, Hostile Planet provides unique access to one of the most extreme environments on the planet.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: In the wake of the largest volcanic eruption of the 1900s, an exploration by National Geographic led to the founding of Katmai National Park. From the volcanic ashes, the landscape regenerated, and a vibrant assembly of wildlife emerged. Witness the annual journey of brown bears, wolves, and salmon within the park.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The polar bear is the world's largest land predator-but it's born blind and deaf. How does a helpless cub become a successful killer? Built for the Kill: Polar Bear exposes real life and death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail. The cub spends about three years at its mother's side, learning to navigate the harsh Arctic environment.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Shark vs Whale
programme.desc: A routine drone survey turns deadly when Ryan Johnson, a marine biologist based in South Africa, films a humpback whale being attacked and strategically drowned by a Great white shark. This is a total perspective shift on a creature he's spent his life studying. To make sense of this event, Ryan follows Humpback whales on their migration, mapping their weak spots. He also takes a new look at Great White sharks. How do they become whale killers?

programme.title: Shark vs Predator
programme.desc: Rare and remarkable instances of predation on sharks by a variety of species, capture by both daring photographers and unlikely bystanders, have given us new insight as to how the primacy of an apex predator can be challenged. We will analyze this growing body of footage with the aid of experts in the field, shedding light on how and why these events occur. Whether with talons, tentacles, or teeth, animals are hunting sharks all over the world.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Life along the equator is spectacularly diverse. More than half of the world's species live here. Tropic Thunder is a 6 part archive series about Equator's wildest and most diverse ecosystems - the Amazon, the Andes, the Galapagos Islands, Borneo and Sumatra, Africa, and the Coral Sea. This series features a cornucopia of exotic animals in habitats ranging from steamy rainforests and great grasslands to snowy mountains and great reefs. Although there is access to plentiful food, fierce competition is still part of daily life on the equator. Great currents and trade winds also drive animals to adapt and behave in ways not seen in other wildlife hotspots? Welcome to the jungle, the mountain, the savannah and the rich reef?all part of the Equator's greatest hotspots.

How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Littlefoot: Marlene is dying to go see a concert in the park. But, every time she leaves the zoo she becomes a feral monster! Can the Penguins stop her before she destroys the city? Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. They go the mall and have a blast doing "teenage things" while they wait for the movie. But, as a side effect of her wish, Hazel starts going through the fairy version of puberty: pasta puberty! As she struggles to deal with pesto pimples and mozzarella mood swings, Hazel wishes that Cosmo and Wanda would just get lost! They disappear, leaving Hazel to deal with the zany pasta puberty alone. // Hazel wishes to be a fairy to join Cosmo and Wanda at their Fairy Convention, but since it's against Da Rules, she settles on looking like a fairy instead. Once at the con, however, Hazel stumbles into the DMV booth and signs a "Fairy-fication" certificate, turning her into a real fairy! It also brings her anti-fairy into existence, who steals the certificate. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must get the certificate back from her anti-fairy, or Hazel will be stuck as a fairy forever!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Jasmine, and Winn take an online BFF compatibility test. To their surprise, they fail! Nobody is fazed, except for Hazel, who overthinks the results and wishes that her friends could know exactly what's in her head. Cosmo and Wanda grant the wish, which lands all of them inside Hazel's mind. As they go through her mind like a museum, Hazel continues to overthink everything they see. Now, Hazel must overcome her negative thoughts and battle a literal mind worm to get her friends out! // When Hazel wishes she didn't have a gap in her teeth, the Tooth Fairy fills her gap with a talking tooth, Toothica. At first, she seems like a lot of fun, but when Toothica gets Hazel in trouble with her parents and plans a party in Hazel's mouth Hazel isn't invited to, Hazel decides she wants her gone! The Tooth Fairy, however, takes Toothica's side and is even set on honoring her at a gala. Hazel must find a way to prove Toothica is no good and get back her gap or be stuck with this rotten tooth forever.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When her parents won't let her have french fries for every meal, Hazel wishes for unlimited fries. But Cosmo and Wanda fail to mention that eating so many magical fries would turn her into a potato! For help Cosmo, Wanda, and Hazel pay a visit to Mother Nature, where Hazel accidentally eats the prized "mother potato." Can she reconcile her fry fixation and get back in Mother Nature's good graces, or will Hazel have to face her wrath while stuck as a potato forever? // After Hazel and Marcus watch a scary movie Cosmo and Wanda lent them, paranormal incidents happen in the Wells home. Hazel wishes Marcus had a ghost tracking show to investigate. But Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda learn the ghost is Ghost Pepper, a fairy actress whose spirit was trapped in the video tape. Fearing her capture will reveal fairies' existence, Hazel must convince Marcus to have an "exorcism" as a cover to send her back to Fairy World.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Anglijos futbolo lygos čempionatas. „Stoke City“ - Sautamptono FC
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Kelno FC - Volfsburgo VfL
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: La Liga. Elche CF - Barselonos FC
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Follow all the exciting action from the EFL Cup, currently known as the Carabao Cup for sponsorship reasons. Organised by the EFL - English Football League, and held annually, this football competition includes all clubs from the EFL and Premier League.

programme.title: La Liga. Elche CF - Barselonos FC
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Assumendone l'identita', vuole farsi rivelare dal fratello di Castor il nascondiglio di una bomba micidiale che si annida nel cuore di Los Angeles. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Sing 2 - Sempre più forte
programme.desc: Sequel di successo del musical animato targato Illumination. Il koala Buster Moon e i suoi amici affrontano ogni imprevisto per esibirsi nel prestigioso Crystal Tower Theater.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Avventure fantasy per Robin Williams. Due ragazzi rimangono intrappolati nei pericolosi labirinti di un gioco da tavolo e affrontano ogni tipo di insidia per liberarsi.

programme.title: Chi ha incastrato Babbo Natale?
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Christian De Sica, Diletta Leotta e Angela Finocchiaro. Per far fallire Babbo Natale, un'azienda infiltra un truffatore al Polo Nord.

programme.title: Rock Dog 2
programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: Tartarughe Ninja
programme.desc: Le valorose tartarughe mutanti tornano in un action mozzafiato con Megan Fox. Le sorti di New York, soggiogata da Shredder, sono nelle mani dell'eroico quartetto e di una bella reporter.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.desc: Stefano Sollima dirige Benicio Del Toro e Josh Brolin nel sequel di "Sicario". Ingaggiato dall'FBI, un uomo misterioso intensifica la guerra al narcotraffico fra Messico e Stati Uniti.

programme.desc: Terzo capitolo con Will Smith e Tommy Lee Jones, protettori del pianeta dagli alieni. L’agente J viaggia nel tempo fino al 1969 per modificare il passato e salvare la vita al collega K.

programme.desc: Sullivan Stapleton ed Eva Green nell'epico sequel di "300". L'esercito ateniese, guidato dallo stratega Temistocle, sfida gli invasori persiani comandati dal semidio Serse.

programme.desc: Action sulla lotta tra umani e divinità con Henry Cavill e Stephen Dorff. Il giovane Teseo è scelto da Zeus per fermare il piano di Iperione: scatenare i titani contro gli dei.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Azione e nostalgia nel terzo capitolo della saga con Will Smith e Martin Lawrence. I detective Lowrey e Burnett fanno di nuovo squadra per fermare la killer di un cartello messicano, evasa dal carcere con l’obiettivo di vendicarsi dei responsabili del suo arresto.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Simon West ('Con Air') dirige Nicolas Cage in un action con Josh Lucas e Malin Akerman. Durante una rapina qualcuno lo ha tradito, cosi' Will Montgomery si e' fatto qualche anno di carcere. Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

programme.title: Geostorm
programme.desc: Disaster-movie con Gerard Butler. Una rete di satelliti che controlla le condizioni climatiche della Terra sfugge al controllo: uno scienziato deve impedire una tempesta globale.

programme.desc: Chris Hemsworth e Tessa Thompson nel quarto capitolo della saga, prodotto da Steven Spielberg. Molly era solo una bambina quando scopri' l'esistenza dei Men in Black. Da allora ha coltivato il sogno di entrare nella famigerata agenzia segreta. Scoperto il quartier generale, convince l'agente O a concederle un periodo di prova. Al fianco di un collega deve smascherare una spia nella filiale di Londra, mentre una nuova stirpe di alieni minaccia il mondo. Spin-off della saga ispirata ai fumetti Marvel di Lowell Cunningham, il film e' diretto da F. Gary Gary, regista di "Fast & Furious 8'.

Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il matrimonio di Pasquali
programme.desc: 29esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. A Pineta, Massimo deve vedersela con i bimbi, nel frattempo Pasquali è alle prese con il suo matrimonio in Calabria.

programme.title: Benvenuti in casa Esposito
programme.desc: Prodotta da Alessandro Siani, commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Giovanni Esposito e Antonia Truppo, ispirata al libro di Pino Imperatore. Alla morte di un boss camorrista, il figlio, incapace di seguirne le orme, si cimenta in goffi tentativi di riscossione del pizzo.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Una Pallottola Spuntata E Dracula - L'amore Perduto - Questo O Quello - Una Pallottola Spuntata E Dracula - L'amore Perduto.

programme.title: Con chi viaggi
programme.desc: Gli YouNuts! dirigono una comedy on the road con Fabio Rovazzi, Lillo, Alessandra Mastronardi e Michela De Rossi. Una app di Car-Sharing riunisce 4 sconosciuti in un viaggio avventuroso.

programme.title: Tonno spiaggiato
programme.desc: Black comedy con Frank Matano nel ruolo di uno strampalato killer per amore. Per riconquistare la sua ex fidanzata, Francesco decide di ucciderle un membro della famiglia.

programme.title: La rivincita delle sfigate
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Olivia Wilde con una commedia sulla trasgressione. Per recuperare il tempo passato a studiare, due studentesse decidono di trascorrere una lunga notte di eccessi.

programme.title: Gli anni belli
programme.desc: Maria Grazia Cucinotta e Ninni Bruschetta in una commedia ambientata negli anni 90. Costretta a passare le vacanze nel solito campeggio, la ribelle Elena vivra' un'estate indimenticabile.

programme.title: Una pallottola spuntata
programme.desc: Dopo aver sgominato una rapina, l'indagine su un caso di possibile suicidio porta Frank Drebin jr. sulle tracce di Richard Cane, magnate della tecnologia che ha escogitato un piano criminoso per riportare l'umanità a uno stadio primordiale e ferino.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Starsky & Hutch
programme.desc: Il telefilm culto degli anni 70 diventa una commedia poliziesca con Ben Stiller e Owen Wilson. Indagando su un omicidio, i due detective seguono la pista che conduce a un narcotrafficante.

programme.title: Una famiglia mostruosa
programme.desc: Commedia dal tocco fantastico di Volfango De Biasi con Massimo Ghini, Lucia Ocone e Lillo. Due fidanzati aspettano un figlio e si preparano a conoscere le rispettive famiglie... mostruose.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Reboot al femminile del cult anni 80 con Melissa McCarthy, Kristen Wiig e Chris Hemsworth. Sfidando lo scetticismo degli accademici, quattro donne formano un team di acchiappafantasmi.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il gioco delle coppie
programme.desc: La Commissaria Fusco e i suoi agenti indagano sulla misteriosa scomparsa di una donna. Pasquali fa di tutto per scampare al matrimonio con Susanita, escogitando scuse sempre più improbabili pur di rimandare l'inevitabile.

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).
